svg.text: The step well (record g28) as the showcase holds it
showcase region saved 11-18 12:36Z (ci2 ~/world18full); nothing was dug or placed at the step well after 11-16 16:00Z, so this is its form today
view from the north-west; blocks y 55..78 (terrain below y 55 cut away), x -73..-35, z -93..-55
-58,70,-74: the bridge dirt that held the tank
the bridge dirt (red edge): the cut that held the tank
magenta edge: other solid blocks with air under them above the rim, inside the box + 2 (bridge leftovers, hill blocks left over dug cells; trees not counted)
blue dashes: the record's box, drawn at the rim (ground y 62)
